function.name: get_session_thread_data
function.description: This function retrieves the session data associated with the current user thread. If no session data exists, it allocates memory for it.
function.return_type: struct session_thread_data pointer, representing the session data associated with the current user thread

function.name: shared_object_acquire_seqlock
function.description: This function acquires a sequence lock on a shared object. It continuously reads the sequence number of the object until it gets an even number, yielding the processor each time it gets an odd number.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: This is the shared object on which the sequence lock is to be acquired.

parameters.name: seq
parameters.description: This is the pointer to a 64-bit unsigned integer where the sequence number of the object will be stored.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: shared_object_release_seqlock
function.description: This function checks if the sequence number of a shared object matches a given sequence number.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: Pointer to the shared object

parameters.name: seq
parameters.description: The sequence number to be compared with the object's sequence number

function.return_type: BOOL, returns true if the sequence number of the object matches the given sequence number, false otherwise

function.name: shared_object_get_id
function.description: This function acquires a sequence lock on a shared object, retrieves the object's ID, and then releases the sequence lock.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: This is the shared object whose ID is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: object_id_t, which represents the ID of the shared object

function.name: map_shared_session_block
function.description: This function maps a shared session block in memory. It opens a section, maps a view of the section, adds the block to a list of session blocks, and sets the return value to the block. If any step fails, it cleans up and returns an error status.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset at which to start the mapping.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the block to map.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a session_block structure. This is where the function will store the pointer to the mapped block.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns STATUS_SUCCESS. If it fails, it returns an error status code.

function.name: find_shared_session_block
function.description: This function finds a shared session block in a list of session blocks. If it doesn't find a suitable block, it attempts to map a new one.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset at which to start the search for the session block

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the session block to find

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a session block structure. This is where the function will store the address of the found or newly mapped session block

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if a suitable block is found, otherwise returns the status of the map_shared_session_block function

function.name: find_shared_session_object
function.description: This function is used to find a shared session object based on the provided object id and offset. It returns a pointer to the shared object if found and matches the id, otherwise it returns NULL.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: This is the id of the shared object to be found.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: This is the offset to be used when finding the shared object.

function.return_type: shared_object_t pointer. It represents the shared object found based on the provided id and offset. If no matching object is found, it returns NULL.

function.name: shared_session_init
function.description: This function initializes a shared session by finding a shared session block and mapping it to the shared session. If the mapping fails, it logs an error message.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: get_shared_desktop
function.description: This function retrieves a shared desktop object and its associated lock. If the shared desktop object does not exist, it attempts to find it. If the lock is not valid or the sequence lock of the shared object cannot be released, it acquires a sequence lock on the shared object and sets the desktop_shm pointer to the shared memory of the desktop object.

parameters.name: lock
parameters.description: A pointer to an object_lock structure. This lock is used to synchronize access to the shared desktop object.

parameters.name: desktop_shm
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a desktop_shm_t structure. This parameter is used to return a pointer to the shared memory of the desktop object.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS. It represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, STATUS_PENDING if a sequence lock on the shared object is acquired, and STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE if the shared desktop object cannot be found.

function.name: get_shared_queue
function.description: This function retrieves a shared message queue. It first checks if the shared queue is already available in the session thread data. If not, it sends a request to the server to get the message queue. It then finds the shared session object using the locator returned from the server. If the object is not found, it returns an invalid handle status. If the object is found, it checks if the lock's id is valid and if the shared object's sequence lock can be released. If not, it acquires the sequence lock, sets the queue_shm to the shared object's queue, sets the lock's id to the object's id, and returns a pending status. If the sequence lock can be released, it returns a success status.

parameters.name: lock
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the object lock structure. It is used to manage access to the shared queue.

parameters.name: queue_shm
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the shared memory queue. It is used to store the address of the shared queue.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. It can be STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE if the shared object is not found, STATUS_PENDING if the sequence lock is acquired, or STATUS_SUCCESS if the sequence lock can be released.

function.name: try_get_shared_input
function.description: This function attempts to get shared input from a thread. If the object is not found in the cache, it makes a server request to get the thread input. It then checks the validity of the object and locks it. If the object is invalidated, it resets the cache and lock.

parameters.name: tid
parameters.description: Thread identifier

parameters.name: lock
parameters.description: Pointer to the object lock structure

parameters.name: input_shm
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer of shared memory input type

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: Pointer to the shared input cache structure

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_PENDING if the object is locked, STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE if the object is not found, and STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful.

function.name: get_shared_input
function.description: This function retrieves shared input from a session thread data. It checks the thread id (tid) and based on its value, it assigns a cache. If the tid doesn't match with the cache's tid, it resets the cache. It then tries to get the shared input and repeats until it gets a status and an id in the cache.

parameters.name: tid
parameters.description: The thread id to check and assign cache based on its value

parameters.name: lock
parameters.description: Pointer to the object lock structure

parameters.name: input_shm
parameters.description: Double pointer to the shared memory input type

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation

function.name: is_virtual_desktop
function.description: This function checks if the current desktop is a virtual desktop by accessing shared memory. It uses a loop to continuously check the status of the shared desktop until it is no longer pending. If the status is not zero after the loop, it sets the return value to FALSE.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not accept any parameters.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the current desktop is a virtual desktop or not.

function.name: is_service_process
function.description: This function checks if the current process is a service process by comparing the name of the process window station with a predefined name.
function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the current process is a service process, otherwise FALSE

function.name: NtUserCreateWindowStation
function.description: This function creates a new window station, sets the last Win32 error if the object name length exceeds the maximum path, and returns a handle to the new window station.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Pointer to an OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES structure that contains the name, attributes, and root directory for the window station.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Specifies the access to the window station.

parameters.name: arg3
parameters.description: Not used in this function.

parameters.name: arg4
parameters.description: Not used in this function.

parameters.name: arg5
parameters.description: Not used in this function.

parameters.name: arg6
parameters.description: Not used in this function.

parameters.name: arg7
parameters.description: Not used in this function.

function.return_type: HWINSTA. It represents a handle to the newly created window station. If the function fails, it returns 0.

function.name: NtUserOpenWindowStation
function.description: This function opens a window station with specified attributes and access.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Pointer to the attributes of the window station to be opened

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: The access mask that specifies the requested types of access to the window station

function.return_type: HWINSTA, represents a handle to the opened window station

function.name: NtUserCloseWindowStation
function.description: This function closes a window station.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the window station to be closed.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the window station was successfully closed or not.

function.name: NtUserGetProcessWindowStation
function.description: This function is used to get the window station for the current process.
function.return_type: HWINSTA, represents a handle to the window station for the current process

function.name: NtUserSetProcessWindowStation
function.description: This function sets the window station for the current process.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the window station.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the window station was successfully set or not.

function.name: NtUserCreateDesktopEx
function.description: This function creates a new desktop with specified attributes, device settings, access permissions, and heap size. It also handles errors related to invalid parameters and filename range exceeding the limit.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Pointer to the object attributes for the new desktop

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Pointer to the device settings for the new desktop

parameters.name: devmode
parameters.description: Pointer to the device mode settings for the new desktop

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to specify additional options or settings

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Access permissions for the new desktop

parameters.name: heap_size
parameters.description: Size of the heap for the new desktop

function.return_type: HDESK, represents a handle to the newly created desktop. If the function fails, it returns 0.

function.name: NtUserOpenDesktop
function.description: This function opens a desktop object, modifies the access rights, checks if the object name length exceeds the maximum path length, and sets the last error to ERROR_FILENAME_EXCED_RANGE if it does. It then starts a server request to open the desktop, sets the necessary parameters, adds data to the server, and if the server call is successful, it sets the return value to the server pointer handle.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Pointer to an OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES structure that contains the name, attributes, and root directory that are used when opening the new desktop.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: The flags that control the behavior of the function.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: The access mask that specifies the requested access to the desktop. It is modified within the function to include DESKTOP_READOBJECTS and DESKTOP_WRITEOBJECTS.

function.return_type: HDESK. It represents a handle to the opened desktop. If the function fails, it returns 0.

function.name: NtUserCloseDesktop
function.description: This function closes a desktop, freeing the associated resources.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the desktop that needs to be closed.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the desktop was successfully closed, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: NtUserGetThreadDesktop
function.description: This function retrieves the desktop associated with a specific thread.

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: This is the identifier of the thread for which the desktop is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: HDESK, represents a handle to the desktop associated with the specified thread.

function.name: NtUserSetThreadDesktop
function.description: This function sets the desktop associated with a specific thread. It also updates the display cache if the desktop was a virtual desktop.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the desktop to be associated with the thread.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the operation was successful or not.

function.name: NtUserOpenInputDesktop
function.description: This function opens the input desktop, modifies the access permissions and returns a handle to the desktop.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags that control the behavior of the function.

parameters.name: inherit
parameters.description: Determines whether the returned handle can be inherited by child processes.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Specifies the requested access rights to the desktop.

function.return_type: HDESK, a handle to the opened input desktop.

function.name: NtUserSwitchDesktop
function.description: This function switches the input desktop to the one specified by the handle.

parameters.name: desktop
parameters.description: Handle to the desktop to switch to.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the desktop was successfully switched, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: NtUserBuildNameList
function.description: This function builds a list of names from a window station object, given a handle to the object, a size for the list, a pointer to the list, and a pointer to the return size.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the window station object.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the list to be built.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Pointer to the list where the names will be stored.

parameters.name: ret_size
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable where the function will store the size of the built list.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, the function returns STATUS_SUCCESS. If the size is less than or equal to the header size, it returns STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE. If memory allocation fails, it returns STATUS_NO_MEMORY. If the buffer is too small, it returns STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL.

function.name: NtUserGetObjectInformation
function.description: This function retrieves information about a user object for the specified handle and index. It handles different cases based on the index value.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: A handle to the user object

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: An index that determines the type of information to be retrieved

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to the buffer that receives the information

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The size, in bytes, of the buffer pointed to by the info parameter

parameters.name: needed
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the number of bytes required to store the requested information

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds; otherwise, FALSE. If the buffer is too small to receive all of the information, the function returns FALSE and stores the required buffer size into the variable pointed to by needed.

function.name: NtUserSetObjectInformation
function.description: This function sets the information for a user object. It checks the validity of the parameters, sets the last error to ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER if they are invalid, and makes a server call to set the user object information.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: A handle to the user object.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The index of the information to be set.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to the information to be set.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of the information to be set.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the server call to set the user object information is successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: get_desktop_window
function.description: This function retrieves the desktop window for the current thread. If the top window does not exist, it creates a new explorer desktop window unless the process is a service. It also registers built-in classes.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters

function.return_type: HWND, which represents a handle to the top window of the current thread

function.name: get_winstations_dir_handle
function.description: This function returns a handle to the directory of window stations for the current session. It first constructs the path to the directory, then attempts to open it and returns the handle if successful.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: HANDLE, which represents a handle to the directory of window stations. If the function fails to open the directory, it returns 0.

function.name: get_default_desktop
function.description: This function retrieves the default desktop from the Wine registry or returns a default value if it cannot be found. It also processes the application's image path name.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Buffer to hold the registry key value data

parameters.name: buf_size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer

function.return_type: WCHAR (pointer to a wide character string). It represents the default desktop retrieved from the Wine registry or a default value if it cannot be found.

function.name: winstation_init
function.description: This function initializes a window station and desktop for the current process. It first checks if a window station is already set for the process, if not, it creates a new one. It then checks if a desktop is set for the current thread, if not, it creates a new one. The function also handles memory allocation and deallocation for the window station and desktop names.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything
